newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS trims Singapore banks forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS trims Singapore banks forecasts.

text.p: UBS Securities Global Research said on Tuesday it was trimming earnings forecasts for some Singapore banks due to their Thai loan exposures.
The research house said it had earlier played down Singapore banks' exposure to Thai loans.
"We believe there is a need to trim our earnings forecasts on the assumption that the need for specific provisioning will arise," UBS said in a report.

"We believe there is reason to expect that a deterioration in Thai credit will adversely affect Singapore bank earnings over the near term. We have therefore downgraded our earnings forecasts and sector recommendation to HOLD," it said.
The report was DBS Bank, Keppel Bank and Tat Lee Bank had the greatest exposure to the risks associated with adverse developments in the Thai market.
The report said UBS believed DBS was the most exposed with US$11.5 million in potentially bad loans to Finance One.
It said all the Singapore banking groups, with the exception of OCBC Bank, were expected to be affected by the fall-out in Thailand.
